body.p: This Election is in response to the Office Action, dated February 22, 2023 ("Office Action"). Claims 1-26 are pending. Examination of the claims in view of the ensuing remarks is respectfully requested.
In the Office Action, the Examiner required a restriction under 35 U.S.C. 121 among the following groups:
I. Claims 1-21, drawn to a system for testing the breath of a patient, classified in
II. Claim 22-26, drawn to a method of sensing gas concentration in exhaled breath,
The Examiner asserts that these groups are independent and distinct for reasons of record.

Applicant hereby elects Group I which reads upon claims 1 -21 for prosecution on the merits. Since the elected claims 1-21 are directed to the product/apparatus, as indicated by the Examiner, when all product/apparatus claims are subsequently found allowable, withdrawn process claims 22-26, which include all the limitations of an allowable product/apparatus claims, should be considered for rejoinder.

Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge the required fees to Deposit Account No. 50- 4181. If additional fees are believed necessary, the Commissioner is further authorized to charge any deficiency or credit any overpayment to Deposit Account No. 50-4181.
All of the claims remaining in the application are now believed to be allowable. Favorable consideration and a Notice of Allowance are earnestly solicited.
If questions remain regarding this application, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at (213) 629-6000.
Respectfully submitted, Mark Pimentel et al.
